verdict.rationale: The only first-party bulk capability in the evidence is ingestion: users can push raw data or user lists for access reviews via CSV upload or an API endpoint, and Secureframe normalizes and maps them. Nothing documents bulk actions on existing items. The REST API and MCP server are building blocks a user could script against, not a bulk-operations feature, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/update/delete or bulk status changes across controls, tests, vendors, risks or tasks; batch API endpoints or MCP batch tools; independent or hands-on corroboration.
